page.overview:
Who is Piava?

She fought with Egwene al'Vere at the Last Battle. Her Warder and Sleete guarded the area where Egwene, Silviana Brehon, and Gawyn Trakand were fighting in one of the early battles.

Because she has a Warder who is not an Asha'man, she is not Red Ajah. It is also unlikely that she is White because few of them have Warders and probably not Yellow as well because the majority of the Ajah was in Mayene.

She is named after Pia Maria Vaajakallio, a Finnish fan who was one of a number of people involved in a competition to have a character named after them.
